yaml.subtitle: Website Tracking | Digital Performance | Marketing Analytics

markdown.markdown:
This portfolio website is connected to Google Analytics to track visitor activity and understand how users interact with my site.

Google Analytics is important in digital marketing because it helps marketers measure website traffic, user behavior, and engagement. This connects to my interest in marketing analytics because it shows how data can be used to evaluate digital performance.

---

## Purpose of Google Analytics

The purpose of adding Google Analytics to this website is to better understand how visitors use my portfolio.

With Google Analytics, I can track information such as:

- How many people visit my website
- Which pages receive the most views
- How visitors move through the website
- How long users stay on pages
- Where traffic comes from
- Which content gets the most engagement

---

## Marketing Value

Google Analytics helps turn website activity into useful marketing insights.

For example, if one project page receives more views than another, that could show which type of content is more interesting to visitors. If visitors leave quickly, that may show that a page needs stronger content, clearer navigation, or a better design.

This type of information is useful for marketers because it supports better decision-making.

---

## Skills Demonstrated

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Digital Marketing
- Website performance tracking
- Audience behavior
- Traffic analysis
- Engagement measurement
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Marketing Analytics
- Data interpretation
- Performance metrics
- Page view analysis
- User behavior insights
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Website Tools
- Google Analytics
- Quarto
- GitHub Pages
- SEO basics
:::

:::

---

## Metrics I Can Monitor

| Metric | What It Shows | Why It Matters |
|---|---|---|
| Page views | How many times pages are viewed | Shows which content attracts attention |
| Users | Number of people visiting the site | Measures audience reach |
| Traffic source | Where visitors come from | Helps understand how people find the site |
| Engagement | How users interact with the site | Shows whether content is useful |
| Popular pages | Most visited pages | Helps identify strongest portfolio sections |

---

## Connection to My Career Goals

Google Analytics connects to my interest in digital marketing and marketing analytics. It allows me to see how real users interact with my portfolio and use that information to improve the website.

This supports my career goal of working in marketing roles that combine creativity, data, and strategy.

---

## Key Takeaway

Adding Google Analytics helped me understand how website data can be used to measure performance. It also made my portfolio stronger because it shows that I can connect marketing content with analytics tools.
